preservationReasons.Plus: Plus is the standard Czech name of the mathematical and numeric-keypad key.
preservationReasons.Minus: Minus is the standard Czech name of the mathematical and numeric-keypad key.
preservationReasons.EnlW: EnlW is an opaque platform virtual-key identifier with no established Czech expansion, so changing it would invent a meaning.
preservationReasons.Attn: Attn is the standardized legacy terminal-key label and is retained so it can be matched to hardware.
preservationReasons.Pa1: Pa1 is the standardized legacy terminal-key identifier and has no Czech lexical form.
